label: Product name
notes: Trivial name plus systematic/INN where one exists.

label: Sequence
notes: One-letter code; note D-amino acids, N-terminal acetylation and C-terminal amidation explicitly.

label: Molecular formula
notes: Must include counter-ion and hydration state where known.

label: Salt / counter-ion form
notes: e.g. acetate, TFA, hydrochloride. TFA content changes both mass and biological comparability.

label: Batch / lot number
notes: Must be traceable to the testing report.

label: Chromatographic purity
notes: State the detection wavelength and method; area-% is not the same as content.

label: Assay / content
notes: Mass balance basis for the declared quantity.

label: Impurity profile
notes: Individual named impurities above the reporting threshold.

label: Mass spectrometry result
notes: Observed vs theoretical; include the ion mode.

label: Residual solvents
notes: Where applicable to the synthesis route.

label: Trifluoroacetic acid (TFA) content
notes: Relevant when the salt form matters for downstream assay.

label: Storage conditions
notes: Temperature and light protection; state whether lyophilised or in solution.

label: Testing laboratory
notes: Name and, where available, accreditation or registration identifier.
